title: Attraction and dating
learning_outcomes: Explain attraction and autonomy in the context of attraction and dating.
Compare and distinguish interest and entitlement in the context of attraction and dating.
Apply compatibility in the context of attraction and dating.
Evaluate and justify decisions about respectful invitations in the context of attraction and dating.

lessons.title: Attraction and autonomy
lessons.outcome: Explain attraction and autonomy in the context of attraction and dating.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving attraction and autonomy; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to dating scenario analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain attraction and autonomy from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of attraction and autonomy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Interest and entitlement
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish interest and entitlement in the context of attraction and dating.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving interest and entitlement; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to dating scenario analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain interest and entitlement from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of interest and entitlement; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Compatibility
lessons.outcome: Apply compatibility in the context of attraction and dating.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving compatibility; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.

lessons.knowledge_check: Explain compatibility from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of compatibility; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Respectful invitations
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about respectful invitations in the context of attraction and dating.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving respectful invitations; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to dating scenario analysis.

Accurate explanation of interest and entitlement; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
